name: record_01
evidence: Human TfRC knock-in mice received IV doses. At 24 hours, cold-PBS perfusion and capillary depletion were performed; the supernatant was called the parenchymal fraction. Concentrations were measured with anti-human-IgG sandwich ELISA and standard curves.

name: record_02
evidence: Figure 4 compares anti-TfR at 1.8 mg/kg with equimolar anti-BACE1 at 1.7 mg/kg. The narrative reports approximately 10–20-fold greater parenchymal signal and about 10% of control plasma signal. Exact candidate-specific numerical values are not supplied here.

name: record_03
evidence: In the matched-clone format study, monoVHH at 5.5 mg/kg exceeded biVHH at 6 mg/kg in 24-hour parenchymal signal. Figure 6 showed no depleted brain TfR on western blot, with GAPDH as loading control.

name: record_04
evidence: The inspected report does not give fraction-purity markers, extraction recovery, intact-cargo measurements, free interstitial concentrations or unbound fractions.
